tester_calibration_mismatches.explanation: model.initial_state calls decimal(raw['quantity'], positive=True) which raises SafetyViolation('DECIMAL_BOUNDS') rather than 'APPROVAL_FIXTURE_INVALID'. The sidecar failed closed and rejected the zero-quantity token before state creation.

Helper build_state_at_phase uses default last_close='100'. At TP1 bar (last_close='106'), tier=0.005 has notional 0.005 * 106 = 0.53 < MIN_NOTIONAL (1.0), so reducer.transition correctly raised SafetyViolation('PARTIAL_LOT_OR_MIN_NOTIONAL'). This accidentally served as a positive witness that TP1 enforces min-notional on the split tier.

Helper build_state_at_phase uses default last_close='100'. At PLACE, qty=0.003 has notional 0.003 * 100 * 1.0005 = 0.30015 < MIN_NOTIONAL (1.0), so reducer.transition correctly raised SafetyViolation('ONE_X_OR_MIN_NOTIONAL').

In sub-case 2 of the test, build_state_at_phase('OPEN', quantity='0.001') used default last_close='100', so notional=0.10005 < MIN_NOTIONAL (1.0) failed closed at PLACE ('ONE_X_OR_MIN_NOTIONAL') before reaching OPEN/TP1. Because post-freeze test code edits are forbidden, this receipt is preserved unaltered.
